question: What will be the average daily mean temperature in Madrid over the 7 days ending September 22, 2026, in degrees Celsius?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the mean of the daily mean 2-metre air temperatures from 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-22 at latitude 40.42, longitude -3.7 (Madrid), from the ERA5 reanalysis as served by the Open-Meteo historical weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com), in degrees Celsius.

# Madrid, 7-day mean temperature for 16-22 Sep 2026 (ERA5 via Open-Meteo): research notes as of 2026-09-01

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Open-Meteo archive API (ERA5): the `temperature_2m_mean` daily values at 40.42, -3.7, averaged over 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-22. I queried it directly with the Europe/Madrid timezone. Open-Meteo's default timezone is GMT, which can change daily means slightly.
- Latest values I pulled, from late August 2026 (°C): 08-24 23.8, 08-25 22.8, 08-26 23.7, 08-27 18.6, 08-28 19.0, 08-29 22.5, 08-30 25.2, 08-31 26.5. Mid-August was hotter: 08-17 29.6, 08-18 31.1, 08-19 30.3. [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=40.42&longitude=-3.7&start_date=2026-08-15&end_date=2026-08-31&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=Europe%2FMadrid)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. The window starts 15 days after the forecast deadline, beyond reliable deterministic forecast range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-01: Madridinforma reports AEMET's forecast for Madrid city: highs of 34°C on Sep 1, 36°C on Sep 2, 37°C on Sep 3 and 38°C on Sep 4 (lows of about 20-22°C). Clouds and possible rain are expected around Sep 5-6, with highs of about 20-31°C on Sep 6. AEMET warned the heat would increase. The article only covers the first week of September. [madridinforma](https://madridinforma.es/?p=61294)
- 2026-08-31 (approx.): Madrid reached 33°C, and AEMET expected more heat at the start of September. [madridinforma](https://madridinforma.eldiario.es/?p=61247)
- Overall, the start of the season is warm: daily means in mid-to-late August 2026 were mostly 23-31°C, apart from a cooler 27-28 Aug.
- I could not find any AEMET or ECMWF extended outlook covering 16-22 Sep that was published by 2026-09-01. Search results dated after 2026-09-01 were ignored.

## 4. Base rates (same source, same 16-22 Sep window, timezone Europe/Madrid)
- 2016: 18.6 | 2017: 18.8 | 2018: 24.2 | 2019: 19.4 | 2020: 18.9 | 2021: 17.9 | 2022: 21.4 | 2023: 16.9 | 2024: 19.4 | 2025: 24.4 (°C). Sources: [2016-2025 query](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=40.42&longitude=-3.7&start_date=2016-09-16&end_date=2025-09-22&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=Europe%2FMadrid), plus single-year queries for 2020-2024 (e.g. [2023](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=40.42&longitude=-3.7&start_date=2023-09-16&end_date=2023-09-22&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=Europe%2FMadrid)).
- 10-year statistics: mean about 20.0°C, median about 19.2°C, standard deviation about 2.5°C, range 16.9 to 24.4°C. The distribution is right-skewed: 7 of 10 years fell between 17.9 and 19.4°C, and 2 years were warm outliers above 24°C (2018 and 2025).
- Daily swings inside the window can be large. In 2025 the daily mean went 26.6, 26.9, 27.5, 27.3, 25.6, 21.3, 15.8, with a front arriving on the last days. In 2020 it went from 23.3 down to about 17.7.
- Seasonal trend: mid-September in Madrid usually cools by roughly 1-2°C a week. Late August 2026 values (around 19-26°C) suggest that window would land a few degrees lower without anomalous heat.
- Background warming: recent years include two strong warm outliers, but there is no clean trend in this small sample.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this specific question or a close variant.
- I found no published expert or seasonal forecast giving a figure for Madrid on 16-22 Sep 2026 by 2026-09-01. Sources that could be checked before close: ECMWF extended-range weekly anomalies (weeks 3), AEMET's monthly/seasonal outlook, and the Open-Meteo ensemble/seasonal APIs.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Heat in early September (highs forecast at 36-38°C on Sep 2-4) and a possible change around Sep 5-6 will shape the pattern. However, persistence from early September to the 16-22 window is weak.
- Week-2 to week-3 ECMWF/GFS ensemble guidance updated between Sep 1 and Sep 15 will be the main signal. The key questions are whether a ridge or Iberian thermal low persists (pointing to the 2018/2025-type outcome of about 24°C) or an Atlantic trough or DANA arrives (the 2021/2023-type outcome of about 17°C).
- The question resolves from ERA5 data around 2026-09-28. Open-Meteo's ERA5 has about a 5-day lag. Early data may come from ERA5T or preliminary sources and could be revised slightly.
